details.youth_clubs: Seoul e-Paran FC (서울e파란축구팀, 2013), Lee Eul-yong FC U12 (이을용FC, 2014), FC Seoul U15 (오산중학교, 2015-2017), FC Seoul U18 (오산고등학교, 2018-2020)
details.further_information: K League Junior U18 Group A Player of the Year (최우수선수상) In 2024 he transferred to Pohang Steelers in exchange with Kang Hyeon-mu who moved to FC Seoul. Priority nomination direct-call up from FC Seoul U18 to FC Seoul on January 2021. Tae-seok Lee is the son of Eul-yong Lee.Tae-seok Lee is the brother of Seung-joon Lee (Yongin FC).
